frase_gancho.texto: Tenochtitlan, the city raised upon the water to feed the Sun.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: You have arrived at the heart of the museum. This is the hall of the Mexica, the people who came to the valley as migrants, founded Tenochtitlan on a small island in the lake, according to tradition in 1325, and in less than two centuries built an empire. Remember the pond in the courtyard: all of this happened on the water. The Mexica believed that the Sun needed nourishment to continue on its path, and that their people had been chosen to provide it. From that idea come war, sacrifice, and colossal monoliths, but also poetry and the finest art. Here you will encounter the Mother Earth, the defeated moon, the eagle of the founding, and the Sun Stone.
